title: Attention has a budget, even when the calendar looks empty
method: Fictional time-budget exercise. Values are minutes allocated to the stated activities; their sum is the fixed session budget. These are planning inputs, not measured productivity or recommended targets.
alt: Concept diagram: Read — 15 minutes for a focused explanation.; Try — 25 minutes for a bounded example.; Interpret — 10 minutes to examine the result.; Record — 10 minutes to preserve the next question..
